dc to vc: 0031 absent-writer list (hold 22), COMPLETE. Read-only, no runs. Scanned at main 2ec8ac86 (v2 was first run at 89cae16e; re-run because 0195 and 0198 landed code since).

METHOD: scan_v2.py walks shfmt 3.14.1's bash syntax tree (shfmt -ln bash --to-json), follows devbin's own functions transitively, and tiers tools as base, platform, optional and git. The regex v1 was dropped: 125 hits, nearly all false ($((...)) read as a substitution, awk and jq program text split into commands).

THE SHAPE, measured under bash 5.3 with inherit_errexit and set -euo pipefail: a plain, array, mid-value or backtick assignment whose substitution runs an absent tool exits 127. local/declare/export/readonly mask it. Only the last substitution in a statement sets the status. An inner || true holds it. x=$(f), where f runs the absent tool, dies; if f, f || true and < <(f) carry on.

NUMBERS at 2ec8ac86: 50 shell files under bin, lib and tests/lib, all parsed (the 40 other tracked files there are YAML, Markdown and one bats template). 899 plain assignments with a substitution: 426 guarded at the site, 53 of them running a may-be-absent tool; 473 unguarded. 0 masked declarations (git grep finds only three comments warning against the shape: fleet:606, :1482, lib/install:271). 0 backtick forms. 0 unguarded sites whose only risk is a dynamic or path command. 3 held by an inner fallback: shell-gate:290 (jq || true), lib/cmd/check:435 and :455 (erl || true).

FLAGGED: 7, ALL SOUND. NOTHING TO FILE.
- lib/cmd/check:419 (elixir): require_tool elixir at :418, same branch. Reached through gatecmd:111's built name builtin_${cmd}_${opt} via run_gate, so it has no static caller.
- infra.d/mail.d/dmarc:264 (jq) and :300, :301 (through auth_array): the only path is parse_one (:626), reached from parse (:600) or parse_dir (:560, called only from parse at :596). parse runs require_tool xmllint and jq at :588-589 first.
- dmarc:476 (jq): require_tool jq at :468, report's first line.
- lib/cmd/release:703 (git), by ordering: reached only after git add (:696) and git commit (:701), each || cut_fail, which exits 1 (:347-353).
- bin/.devbin/cmd/formula:211 (git), NEW since 89cae16e (0195), by ordering: after git status (:197), add (:203), commit (:205) and symbolic-ref (:207) in the same clone, each || die.
Noted, not this shape: dmarc's xq (:190) reports a failed xmllint as "XPath failed", which would misreport a missing xmllint. Every xq call follows require_tool xmllint at :588.

GUARDED AT THE SITE (53): not this shape. Their guards were NOT read for what they do on a missing tool. Site and tool:
bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib/shell-gate:289 intent; bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib/shell-gate:327 intent; bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet:695 git; bin/.devbin/cmd/formula:115 git; bin/.devbin/cmd/formula:180 git; bin/.devbin/cmd/formula:197 git; bin/.devbin/cmd/formula:207 git; lib/cmd/check:108 jq; lib/cmd/check:121 intent; lib/cmd/check:146 git; lib/cmd/fullcycle:479 git; lib/cmd/infra.d/mail.d/dmarc:145 unzip; lib/cmd/infra.d/mail.d/dmarc:190 xmllint; lib/cmd/release:431 gh; lib/cmd/release:516 git; lib/cmd/release:535 git; lib/cmd/release:739 git; lib/cmd/release:753 git; lib/cmd/release:1220 git; lib/helpers:2219 git; lib/helpers:2378 git; lib/helpers:2380 git; lib/helpers:2402 git; lib/helpers:2403 git; lib/helpers:2527 sha256sum; lib/helpers:2600 git; lib/helpers:2622 git; lib/helpers:2664 git; lib/helpers:3506 git; lib/helpers:3608 git; lib/helpers:3638 git; lib/infra.dns:141 dig; lib/install:344 git; lib/install:766 git; lib/install:769 git; lib/install:874 git; lib/install:1157 sha256sum; lib/install:1428 git; lib/release.steps:102 git; lib/release.steps:178 git; lib/release.steps:182 git; lib/release.steps:416 git; lib/release.steps:470 git; lib/release.steps:475 git; lib/release.steps:476 git; lib/release.steps:520 git; lib/release.steps:611 git; lib/release.steps:799 git; lib/release.steps:810 git; lib/release.steps:891 gh; lib/release.steps:913 gh; lib/release.steps:917 gh; lib/runlog:1558 git; 

LIMITS
- A function called by a built name (builtin_* through run_gate) has no visible caller, so its sites were read as if called unguarded. That is conservative: it flags, it does not hide.
- The base tier (tools taken as always present) comes from Debian and Ubuntu package priorities and macOS's shipped tools. It was not measured on kovacs or under WSL.
- Out of scope: tests/unit/*.bats and .github (0198's class; GitHub's runners carry their tools).
- 18 shebang files have no top-level set -e. 17 are sourced libraries: each of lib/{builtins,config,gatecmd,help,helpers,infra,infra.check,infra.dns,infra.init,install,release.notes,release.steps,resolve,runlog} is sourced by at least one handler, and each tests/lib/*.bash by its suites, so they run under their caller's options (eg lib/infra under lib/cmd/infra:32's set -euo pipefail). The 18th is lib/cmd/shell-init, a handler of its own, which runs set -uo pipefail at :39 with no -e, deliberately: it runs from a shell rc and emits dvb even when config cannot be read (:186-195). Its substitutions cannot die with 127, so this shape does not reach it there. An absent tool gives empty output instead, which its own comments treat as deliberate.
- Whether a guarded site handles a missing tool well is a different question, not asked here.

Bank: ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/0031-scan/ (NOTES.md, scan_v2.py, v2-2ec8ac86.out and .json, v2-89cae16e.*). dc archives hold 22 and removes the scan's clone head/ once this is sent.
